theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α : Type u} (check : α → Bool) (xs : List α) (x : α),   FormalSuite.IMultiState.findFirst check xs = some x → check x = true

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (a b : Bool) : gateNand (gateNand a a) (gateNand b b) = gateOr a b

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {n : Nat} (ρ : Fin n → Bool) (a b : NandExpr n) : eval ρ (nandImp a b) = (!(eval ρ a) || eval ρ b)

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {n : Nat} (ρ : Fin n → Bool) (a b : NandExpr n) : eval ρ (nandNor a b) = !(eval ρ a || eval ρ b)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: FormalSuite.INand.NandExpr.eval_nandOr
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {n : Nat} (ρ : Fin n → Bool) (a b : NandExpr n) : eval ρ (nandOr a b) = (eval ρ a || eval ρ b)

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {n : Nat} (ρ : Fin n → Bool) (a b : NandExpr n) : eval ρ (nandXnor a b) = !(Bool.xor (eval ρ a) (eval ρ b))

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {n : Nat} (ρ : Fin n → Bool) (a b : NandExpr n) : eval ρ (nandXor a b) = Bool.xor (eval ρ a) (eval ρ b)
